class_name WeaponModels
extends RefCounted

## 程序化生成第一人称武器模型，工程不依赖任何外部美术资源。
## 模型坐标：镜头前方为 -Z，右手边为 +X，上方为 +Y。

const STEEL_DARK := Color(0.16, 0.17, 0.2)
const STEEL_LIGHT := Color(0.78, 0.81, 0.86)
const GRIP_BROWN := Color(0.32, 0.19, 0.11)
const GOLD := Color(0.85, 0.68, 0.28)


static func build_pistol() -> Node3D:
	var root := Node3D.new()
	root.name = "PistolModel"
	var metal := _metal(STEEL_DARK, 0.35, 0.85)
	var grip_mat := _metal(GRIP_BROWN, 0.8, 0.05)

	# 套筒
	root.add_child(_box(Vector3(0.09, 0.1, 0.34), Vector3(0.0, 0.0, -0.05), metal))
	# 枪管
	root.add_child(_cylinder(0.024, 0.14, Vector3(0.0, 0.006, -0.26), metal))
	# 握把
	var grip := _box(Vector3(0.08, 0.22, 0.1), Vector3(0.0, -0.14, 0.07), grip_mat)
	grip.rotation = Vector3(deg_to_rad(-16.0), 0.0, 0.0)
	root.add_child(grip)
	# 扳机护圈
	root.add_child(_box(Vector3(0.05, 0.02, 0.11), Vector3(0.0, -0.07, -0.02), metal))
	# 准星片
	root.add_child(_box(Vector3(0.02, 0.03, 0.03), Vector3(0.0, 0.07, -0.2), metal))
	return root


static func build_sword() -> Node3D:
	var root := Node3D.new()
	root.name = "SwordModel"
	var blade_mat := _metal(STEEL_LIGHT, 0.18, 0.9)
	var grip_mat := _metal(GRIP_BROWN, 0.8, 0.05)
	var gold_mat := _metal(GOLD, 0.35, 0.8)

	# 剑刃（指向镜头前方 -Z）
	root.add_child(_box(Vector3(0.06, 0.018, 0.78), Vector3(0.0, 0.06, -0.42), blade_mat))
	# 剑尖
	var tip := _box(Vector3(0.045, 0.016, 0.09), Vector3(0.0, 0.06, -0.85), blade_mat)
	tip.rotation = Vector3(0.0, deg_to_rad(45.0), 0.0)
	root.add_child(tip)
	# 护手
	root.add_child(_box(Vector3(0.28, 0.03, 0.05), Vector3(0.0, 0.06, -0.02), gold_mat))
	# 握柄
	root.add_child(_cylinder(0.026, 0.18, Vector3(0.0, 0.06, 0.09), grip_mat))
	# 剑柄尾饰
	root.add_child(_sphere(0.036, Vector3(0.0, 0.06, 0.19), gold_mat))
	return root


static func _box(size: Vector3, pos: Vector3, mat: Material) -> MeshInstance3D:
	var mesh := BoxMesh.new()
	mesh.size = size
	var instance := MeshInstance3D.new()
	instance.mesh = mesh
	instance.position = pos
	instance.material_override = mat
	return instance


static func _cylinder(radius: float, height: float, pos: Vector3, mat: Material) -> MeshInstance3D:
	var mesh := CylinderMesh.new()
	mesh.top_radius = radius
	mesh.bottom_radius = radius
	mesh.height = height
	var instance := MeshInstance3D.new()
	instance.mesh = mesh
	instance.position = pos
	# CylinderMesh 默认沿 +Y，旋转后轴向对齐 Z（枪口 / 剑刃方向）
	instance.rotation = Vector3(PI * 0.5, 0.0, 0.0)
	instance.material_override = mat
	return instance


static func _sphere(radius: float, pos: Vector3, mat: Material) -> MeshInstance3D:
	var mesh := SphereMesh.new()
	mesh.radius = radius
	mesh.height = radius * 2.0
	var instance := MeshInstance3D.new()
	instance.mesh = mesh
	instance.position = pos
	instance.material_override = mat
	return instance


static func _metal(color: Color, roughness: float, metallic: float) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.albedo_color = color
	mat.roughness = roughness
	mat.metallic = metallic
	return mat

extends Node3D

## 第一人称武器挂点。
## 它被 player.gd 直接 add_child 到 Camera3D 下面，
## 所以枪/剑一定跟随视角一起旋转（俯仰 + 偏航都跟随）。
## 切换武器时只切换可见模型，并广播准星样式。

signal weapon_changed(weapon_id, crosshair_style)

const WEAPON_MODELS := preload("res://scripts/weapon_models.gd")

const PISTOL: StringName = &"pistol"
const SWORD: StringName = &"sword"
const CROSSHAIR_PISTOL: StringName = &"pistol"
const CROSSHAIR_SWORD: StringName = &"sword"

## 相机坐标系里的持枪姿态（右下方、镜头前方）
const REST_POSITION := Vector3(0.26, -0.22, -0.42)
const SWING_DURATION := 0.34

var current_weapon: StringName = PISTOL
var crosshair_style: StringName = CROSSHAIR_PISTOL

var _models := {}
var _sway := Vector3.ZERO
var _sway_target := Vector3.ZERO
var _recoil := 0.0
var _swing_time := 0.0
var _bob_time := 0.0
var _move_speed := 0.0
var _grounded := true


func _init() -> void:
	_models[PISTOL] = WEAPON_MODELS.build_pistol()
	_models[SWORD] = WEAPON_MODELS.build_sword()
	for id in _models:
		var model: Node3D = _models[id]
		model.visible = false
		add_child(model)
	position = REST_POSITION


func _ready() -> void:
	_apply_weapon(PISTOL)


func equip(weapon_id: StringName) -> void:
	if not _models.has(weapon_id):
		push_warning("未知武器: %s" % String(weapon_id))
		return
	if weapon_id == current_weapon:
		return
	_apply_weapon(weapon_id)


func toggle_weapon() -> void:
	equip(SWORD if current_weapon == PISTOL else PISTOL)


func _apply_weapon(weapon_id: StringName) -> void:
	current_weapon = weapon_id
	for id in _models:
		var model: Node3D = _models[id]
		model.visible = (id == weapon_id)
	crosshair_style = CROSSHAIR_SWORD if weapon_id == SWORD else CROSSHAIR_PISTOL
	_recoil = 0.0
	_swing_time = 0.0
	weapon_changed.emit(current_weapon, crosshair_style)


func fire() -> void:
	if current_weapon == SWORD:
		_swing_time = SWING_DURATION
	else:
		_recoil = 1.0


func add_look_delta(relative: Vector2) -> void:
	var limit := 0.05
	_sway_target.x = clampf(_sway_target.x - relative.x * 0.0005, -limit, limit)
	_sway_target.y = clampf(_sway_target.y - relative.y * 0.0004, -limit, limit)


func set_move_state(speed: float, grounded: bool) -> void:
	_move_speed = speed
	_grounded = grounded


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	_sway = _sway.lerp(_sway_target, clampf(delta * 10.0, 0.0, 1.0))
	_sway_target = _sway_target.lerp(Vector3.ZERO, clampf(delta * 6.0, 0.0, 1.0))
	_recoil = move_toward(_recoil, 0.0, delta * 5.0)

	var bob := Vector3.ZERO
	if _grounded and _move_speed > 0.3:
		_bob_time += delta * _move_speed
		bob = Vector3(sin(_bob_time * 5.0) * 0.014, -absf(cos(_bob_time * 5.0)) * 0.012, 0.0)

	if _swing_time > 0.0:
		_swing_time = maxf(0.0, _swing_time - delta)
		var t := 1.0 - (_swing_time / SWING_DURATION)
		var arc := sin(t * PI)
		position = REST_POSITION + _sway + bob + Vector3(0.0, -arc * 0.05, 0.0)
		rotation = Vector3(-arc * 1.25, arc * 0.45, arc * 0.85)
	else:
		position = REST_POSITION + _sway + bob + Vector3(0.0, 0.0, _recoil * 0.1)
		rotation = Vector3(-_recoil * 0.4, _sway.x * 1.5, 0.0)

extends CharacterBody3D

## 第一人称玩家。
## - 视角：偏航(yaw)加在身体上，俯仰(pitch)加在头部 Head 上；
## - 武器：WeaponRig 是 Camera3D 的子节点，所以枪/剑跟随视角旋转；
## - 切换武器时广播 weapon_changed，由世界脚本换准星。

signal weapon_changed(weapon_id, crosshair_style)

const WEAPON_RIG_SCRIPT := preload("res://scripts/weapon_rig.gd")
const INPUT_SETUP := preload("res://scripts/input_map_setup.gd")

const WALK_SPEED := 4.6
const SPRINT_SPEED := 7.2
const ACCELERATION := 22.0
const JUMP_VELOCITY := 4.8
const GRAVITY := 12.0
const MOUSE_SENSITIVITY := 0.0022
const PITCH_LIMIT_DEG := 85.0

var camera: Camera3D
var head: Node3D
var weapon_rig

var _yaw := 0.0
var _pitch := 0.0
var _mouse_captured := true


func _init() -> void:
	# 身体碰撞体
	var shape := CollisionShape3D.new()
	shape.name = "Body"
	var capsule := CapsuleShape3D.new()
	capsule.radius = 0.35
	capsule.height = 1.8
	shape.shape = capsule
	shape.position = Vector3(0.0, 0.9, 0.0)
	add_child(shape)

	# 头部（俯仰）
	head = Node3D.new()
	head.name = "Head"
	head.position = Vector3(0.0, 1.6, 0.0)
	add_child(head)

	# 第一人称相机
	camera = Camera3D.new()
	camera.name = "Camera3D"
	camera.fov = 75.0
	camera.near = 0.05
	camera.far = 500.0
	camera.current = true
	head.add_child(camera)

	# 武器挂点：直接挂在相机下 => 跟随视角旋转
	weapon_rig = WEAPON_RIG_SCRIPT.new()
	weapon_rig.name = "WeaponRig"
	camera.add_child(weapon_rig)


func _ready() -> void:
	INPUT_SETUP.ensure_actions()
	_mouse_captured = true
	Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED
	weapon_rig.weapon_changed.connect(_on_weapon_changed)
	_on_weapon_changed(weapon_rig.current_weapon, weapon_rig.crosshair_style)


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventMouseMotion:
		var motion := event as InputEventMouseMotion
		if motion != null and _mouse_captured:
			_look(motion.relative)
		return

	if event.is_action_pressed("release_mouse"):
		_set_mouse_captured(not _mouse_captured)
		return

	if not _mouse_captured:
		if event is InputEventMouseButton and (event as InputEventMouseButton).pressed:
			_set_mouse_captured(true)
		return

	if event.is_action_pressed("weapon_toggle"):
		weapon_rig.toggle_weapon()
	elif event.is_action_pressed("weapon_pistol"):
		weapon_rig.equip(&"pistol")
	elif event.is_action_pressed("weapon_sword"):
		weapon_rig.equip(&"sword")
	elif event.is_action_pressed("fire"):
		weapon_rig.fire()


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not is_on_floor():
		velocity.y -= GRAVITY * delta

	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("jump") and is_on_floor():
		velocity.y = JUMP_VELOCITY

	var input_dir := Input.get_vector("move_left", "move_right", "move_forward", "move_back")
	var direction := (transform.basis * Vector3(input_dir.x, 0.0, input_dir.y)).normalized()
	var sprinting := Input.is_action_pressed("move_forward") and Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_SHIFT)
	var target := direction * (SPRINT_SPEED if sprinting else WALK_SPEED)
	velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, target.x, ACCELERATION * delta)
	velocity.z = move_toward(velocity.z, target.z, ACCELERATION * delta)
	move_and_slide()

	if weapon_rig != null:
		weapon_rig.set_move_state(Vector2(velocity.x, velocity.z).length(), is_on_floor())


func _look(relative: Vector2) -> void:
	_yaw -= relative.x * MOUSE_SENSITIVITY
	_pitch -= relative.y * MOUSE_SENSITIVITY
	_pitch = clampf(_pitch, -deg_to_rad(PITCH_LIMIT_DEG), deg_to_rad(PITCH_LIMIT_DEG))
	rotation.y = _yaw
	head.rotation.x = _pitch
	if weapon_rig != null:
		weapon_rig.add_look_delta(relative)


func _set_mouse_captured(captured: bool) -> void:
	_mouse_captured = captured
	Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED if captured else Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE


func _on_weapon_changed(weapon_id, crosshair_style) -> void:
	weapon_changed.emit(weapon_id, crosshair_style)

extends Control

## 屏幕准星。
## 它是铺满整个视口的 Control（PRESET_FULL_RECT），
## 绘制坐标直接取自视口尺寸的一半 => 永远画在视口正中。
## 样式随武器切换：手枪 = 十字 + 中心点；长剑 = 圆环 + 中心点。

const STYLE_PISTOL: StringName = &"pistol"
const STYLE_SWORD: StringName = &"sword"

const CROSSHAIR_COLOR := Color(0.98, 0.99, 1.0, 0.95)
const SWORD_COLOR := Color(0.96, 0.9, 0.62, 0.95)

const SPREAD_PISTOL := 6.0
const SPREAD_SWORD := 9.0

var style: StringName = STYLE_PISTOL

var _spread := SPREAD_PISTOL


func _ready() -> void:
	# 铺满视口，保证本地坐标 (0,0) 就是视口左上角
	set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
	z_index = 100
	queue_redraw()


func set_style(new_style: StringName) -> void:
	if style == new_style:
		return
	style = new_style
	queue_redraw()


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	var target := SPREAD_SWORD if style == STYLE_SWORD else SPREAD_PISTOL
	var next_spread := lerpf(_spread, target, clampf(delta * 10.0, 0.0, 1.0))
	if absf(next_spread - _spread) > 0.01:
		_spread = next_spread
		queue_redraw()


func _viewport_center() -> Vector2:
	# 视口正中：视口尺寸的一半
	return get_viewport_rect().size * 0.5


func _draw() -> void:
	var center := _viewport_center()
	if style == STYLE_SWORD:
		_draw_sword_style(center)
	else:
		_draw_pistol_style(center)


func _draw_pistol_style(center: Vector2) -> void:
	var color := CROSSHAIR_COLOR
	var gap := _spread
	var length := 8.0
	var width := 2.0
	draw_line(center + Vector2(-gap - length, 0.0), center + Vector2(-gap, 0.0), color, width, true)
	draw_line(center + Vector2(gap, 0.0), center + Vector2(gap + length, 0.0), color, width, true)
	draw_line(center + Vector2(0.0, -gap - length), center + Vector2(0.0, -gap), color, width, true)
	draw_line(center + Vector2(0.0, gap), center + Vector2(0.0, gap + length), color, width, true)
	draw_circle(center, 1.8, color)


func _draw_sword_style(center: Vector2) -> void:
	var color := SWORD_COLOR
	var radius := 15.0
	draw_arc(center, radius, 0.0, TAU, 64, color, 2.0, true)
	# 环上四个刻度，强调“近战”准星
	draw_line(center + Vector2(0.0, -radius - 6.0), center + Vector2(0.0, -radius + 1.0), color, 2.0, true)
	draw_line(center + Vector2(0.0, radius - 1.0), center + Vector2(0.0, radius + 6.0), color, 2.0, true)
	draw_line(center + Vector2(-radius - 6.0, 0.0), center + Vector2(-radius + 1.0, 0.0), color, 2.0, true)
	draw_line(center + Vector2(radius - 1.0, 0.0), center + Vector2(radius + 6.0, 0.0), color, 2.0, true)
	draw_circle(center, 2.2, color)

extends Node3D

## 世界组装脚本（main.tscn 的根节点）。
## 顺序：输入动作 -> 环境/灯光 -> 关卡几何 -> 玩家 -> HUD 准星。

const PLAYER_SCRIPT := preload("res://scripts/player.gd")
const CROSSHAIR_SCRIPT := preload("res://scripts/crosshair.gd")
const INPUT_SETUP := preload("res://scripts/input_map_setup.gd")

const GROUND_SIZE := 60.0

var player
var crosshair
var _weapon_label: Label


func _ready() -> void:
	INPUT_SETUP.ensure_actions()
	_build_environment()
	_build_level()
	_spawn_player()
	_build_hud()


func _build_environment() -> void:
	var env := Environment.new()
	env.background_mode = Environment.BG_SKY
	var sky := Sky.new()
	var sky_mat := ProceduralSkyMaterial.new()
	sky_mat.sky_top_color = Color(0.25, 0.42, 0.7)
	sky_mat.sky_horizon_color = Color(0.66, 0.73, 0.82)
	sky_mat.ground_horizon_color = Color(0.5, 0.5, 0.52)
	sky_mat.ground_bottom_color = Color(0.18, 0.18, 0.2)
	sky.sky_material = sky_mat
	env.sky = sky
	env.ambient_light_source = Environment.AMBIENT_SOURCE_SKY
	env.ambient_light_energy = 0.7

	var world_env := WorldEnvironment.new()
	world_env.name = "WorldEnvironment"
	world_env.environment = env
	add_child(world_env)

	var sun := DirectionalLight3D.new()
	sun.name = "Sun"
	sun.rotation = Vector3(deg_to_rad(-52.0), deg_to_rad(-38.0), 0.0)
	sun.light_energy = 1.2
	sun.shadow_enabled = true
	add_child(sun)


func _build_level() -> void:
	# 地面（顶面在 y = 0）
	_add_platform(Vector3(0.0, -0.5, 0.0), Vector3(GROUND_SIZE, 1.0, GROUND_SIZE), Color(0.33, 0.35, 0.4))
	# 前方靶墙
	_add_platform(Vector3(0.0, 1.5, -18.0), Vector3(26.0, 3.0, 1.0), Color(0.42, 0.4, 0.36))
	# 一排靶箱（正好在准星高度附近）
	for i in 4:
		var x := -6.0 + float(i) * 4.0
		_add_platform(Vector3(x, 0.6, -8.0), Vector3(1.2, 1.2, 1.2), Color(0.74, 0.36, 0.28))
	# 左右墙，给出空间纵深
	_add_platform(Vector3(-14.0, 2.0, -6.0), Vector3(1.0, 4.0, 26.0), Color(0.3, 0.31, 0.34))
	_add_platform(Vector3(14.0, 2.0, -6.0), Vector3(1.0, 4.0, 26.0), Color(0.3, 0.31, 0.34))


func _add_platform(center: Vector3, size: Vector3, color: Color) -> void:
	var body := StaticBody3D.new()
	body.name = "Platform"
	body.position = center

	var shape := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var box := BoxShape3D.new()
	box.size = size
	shape.shape = box
	body.add_child(shape)

	var mesh := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var box_mesh := BoxMesh.new()
	box_mesh.size = size
	mesh.mesh = box_mesh
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.albedo_color = color
	mat.roughness = 0.85
	mesh.material_override = mat
	body.add_child(mesh)

	add_child(body)


func _spawn_player() -> void:
	player = PLAYER_SCRIPT.new()
	player.name = "Player"
	player.position = Vector3(0.0, 0.05, 6.0)
	add_child(player)


func _build_hud() -> void:
	var layer := CanvasLayer.new()
	layer.name = "HUD"
	layer.layer = 10
	add_child(layer)

	# 中央准星（铺满视口的 Control，绘制在视口正中）
	crosshair = CROSSHAIR_SCRIPT.new()
	crosshair.name = "Crosshair"
	layer.add_child(crosshair)

	_weapon_label = Label.new()
	_weapon_label.name = "WeaponLabel"
	_weapon_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 22)
	_weapon_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.96, 0.98, 1.0))
	_weapon_label.add_theme_color_override("font_shadow_color", Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.75))
	_weapon_label.add_theme_constant_override("shadow_offset_x", 1)
	_weapon_label.add_theme_constant_override("shadow_offset_y", 1)
	layer.add_child(_weapon_label)
	_weapon_label.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_BOTTOM_RIGHT)
	_weapon_label.position = Vector2(-300.0, -66.0)

	var help := Label.new()
	help.name = "Help"
	help.text = "WASD 移动 · 鼠标转视角 · Q / 1 / 2 切换武器 · 左键 开火或挥剑 · Esc 释放鼠标"
	help.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16)
	help.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.9, 0.94, 1.0, 0.85))
	layer.add_child(help)
	help.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_LEFT)
	help.position = Vector2(18.0, 14.0)

	player.weapon_changed.connect(_on_weapon_changed)
	# 推送一次初始状态，保证开局准星和标签就是当前武器
	_on_weapon_changed(player.weapon_rig.current_weapon, player.weapon_rig.crosshair_style)


func _on_weapon_changed(weapon_id, crosshair_style) -> void:
	if crosshair != null:
		crosshair.set_style(crosshair_style)
	if _weapon_label != null:
		_weapon_label.text = "当前武器：%s" % _weapon_display_name(weapon_id)


func _weapon_display_name(weapon_id) -> String:
	if weapon_id == &"sword":
		return "长剑（准星：圆环）"
	return "手枪（准星：十字）"

const CROSSHAIR_COLOR := Color(0.98, 0.99, 1.0, 0.95)

extends Control

## 屏幕准星。
## 它是铺满整个视口的 Control（PRESET_FULL_RECT），
## 绘制坐标直接取自视口尺寸的一半 => 永远画在视口正中。
## 样式随武器切换：手枪 = 十字 + 中心点；长剑 = 圆环 + 中心点。

const STYLE_PISTOL: StringName = &"pistol"
const STYLE_SWORD: StringName = &"sword"

const CROSSHAIR_COLOR := Color(0.98, 0.99, 1.0, 0.95)
const SWORD_COLOR := Color(0.96, 0.9, 0.62, 0.95)

const SPREAD_PISTOL := 6.0
const SPREAD_SWORD := 9.0

var style: StringName = STYLE_PISTOL

var _spread := SPREAD_PISTOL


func _ready() -> void:
	# 铺满视口，保证本地坐标 (0,0) 就是视口左上角
	set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
	z_index = 100
	queue_redraw()


func set_style(new_style: StringName) -> void:
	if style == new_style:
		return
	style = new_style
	queue_redraw()


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	var target := SPREAD_SWORD if style == STYLE_SWORD else SPREAD_PISTOL
	var next_spread := lerpf(_spread, target, clampf(delta * 10.0, 0.0, 1.0))
	if absf(next_spread - _spread) > 0.01:
		_spread = next_spread
		queue_redraw()


func _viewport_center() -> Vector2:
	# 视口正中：视口尺寸的一半
	return get_viewport_rect().size * 0.5


func _draw() -> void:
	var center := _viewport_center()
	if style == STYLE_SWORD:
		_draw_sword_style(center)
	else:
		_draw_pistol_style(center)


func _draw_pistol_style(center: Vector2) -> void:
	var color := CROSSHAIR_COLOR
	var gap := _spread
	var length := 8.0
	var width := 2.0
	draw_line(center + Vector2(-gap - length, 0.0), center + Vector2(-gap, 0.0), color, width, true)
	draw_line(center + Vector2(gap, 0.0), center + Vector2(gap + length, 0.0), color, width, true)
	draw_line(center + Vector2(0.0, -gap - length), center + Vector2(0.0, -gap), color, width, true)
	draw_line(center + Vector2(0.0, gap), center + Vector2(0.0, gap + length), color, width, true)
	draw_circle(center, 1.8, color)


func _draw_sword_style(center: Vector2) -> void:
	var color := SWORD_COLOR
	var radius := 15.0
	draw_arc(center, radius, 0.0, TAU, 64, color, 2.0, true)
	# 环上四个刻度，强调“近战”准星
	draw_line(center + Vector2(0.0, -radius - 6.0), center + Vector2(0.0, -radius + 1.0), color, 2.0, true)
	draw_line(center + Vector2(0.0, radius - 1.0), center + Vector2(0.0, radius + 6.0), color, 2.0, true)
	draw_line(center + Vector2(-radius - 6.0, 0.0), center + Vector2(-radius + 1.0, 0.0), color, 2.0, true)
	draw_line(center + Vector2(radius - 1.0, 0.0), center + Vector2(radius + 6.0, 0.0), color, 2.0, true)
	draw_circle(center, 2.2, color)

extends Node3D

## 第一人称武器挂点。
## 它被 player.gd 直接 add_child 到 Camera3D 下面，
## 所以枪/剑一定跟随视角一起旋转（俯仰 + 偏航都跟随）。
## 切换武器时只切换可见模型，并广播准星样式。

signal weapon_changed(weapon_id, crosshair_style)

const WEAPON_MODELS := preload("res://scripts/weapon_models.gd")

const PISTOL: StringName = &"pistol"
const SWORD: StringName = &"sword"
const CROSSHAIR_PISTOL: StringName = &"pistol"
const CROSSHAIR_SWORD: StringName = &"sword"

## 相机坐标系里的持枪姿态（右下方、镜头前方）
const REST_POSITION := Vector3(0.26, -0.22, -0.42)
const SWING_DURATION := 0.34

var current_weapon: StringName = PISTOL
var crosshair_style: StringName = CROSSHAIR_PISTOL

var _models := {}
var _sway := Vector3.ZERO
var _sway_target := Vector3.ZERO
var _recoil := 0.0
var _swing_time := 0.0
var _bob_time := 0.0
var _move_speed := 0.0
var _grounded := true


func _init() -> void:
	_models[PISTOL] = WEAPON_MODELS.build_pistol()
	_models[SWORD] = WEAPON_MODELS.build_sword()
	for id in _models:
		var model: Node3D = _models[id]
		model.visible = false
		add_child(model)
	position = REST_POSITION


func _ready() -> void:
	_apply_weapon(PISTOL)


func equip(weapon_id: StringName) -> void:
	if not _models.has(weapon_id):
		push_warning("未知武器: %s" % String(weapon_id))
		return
	if weapon_id == current_weapon:
		return
	_apply_weapon(weapon_id)


func toggle_weapon() -> void:
	equip(SWORD if current_weapon == PISTOL else PISTOL)


func _apply_weapon(weapon_id: StringName) -> void:
	current_weapon = weapon_id
	for id in _models:
		var model: Node3D = _models[id]
		model.visible = (id == weapon_id)
	crosshair_style = CROSSHAIR_SWORD if weapon_id == SWORD else CROSSHAIR_PISTOL
	_recoil = 0.0
	_swing_time = 0.0
	weapon_changed.emit(current_weapon, crosshair_style)


func fire() -> void:
	if current_weapon == SWORD:
		_swing_time = SWING_DURATION
	else:
		_recoil = 1.0


func add_look_delta(relative: Vector2) -> void:
	var limit := 0.05
	_sway_target.x = clampf(_sway_target.x - relative.x * 0.0005, -limit, limit)
	_sway_target.y = clampf(_sway_target.y - relative.y * 0.0004, -limit, limit)


func set_move_state(speed: float, grounded: bool) -> void:
	_move_speed = speed
	_grounded = grounded


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	_sway = _sway.lerp(_sway_target, clampf(delta * 10.0, 0.0, 1.0))
	_sway_target = _sway_target.lerp(Vector3.ZERO, clampf(delta * 6.0, 0.0, 1.0))
	_recoil = move_toward(_recoil, 0.0, delta * 5.0)

	var bob := Vector3.ZERO
	if _grounded and _move_speed > 0.3:
		_bob_time += delta * _move_speed
		bob = Vector3(sin(_bob_time * 5.0) * 0.014, -absf(cos(_bob_time * 5.0)) * 0.012, 0.0)

	if _swing_time > 0.0:
		_swing_time = maxf(0.0, _swing_time - delta)
		var t := 1.0 - (_swing_time / SWING_DURATION)
		var arc := sin(t * PI)
		position = REST_POSITION + _sway + bob + Vector3(0.0, -arc * 0.05, 0.0)
		rotation = Vector3(-arc * 1.25, arc * 0.45, arc * 0.85)
	else:
		position = REST_POSITION + _sway + bob + Vector3(0.0, 0.0, _recoil * 0.1)
		rotation = Vector3(-_recoil * 0.4, _sway.x * 1.5, 0.0)

extends CharacterBody3D

## 第一人称玩家。
## - 视角：偏航(yaw)加在身体上，俯仰(pitch)加在头部 Head 上；
## - 武器：WeaponRig 是 Camera3D 的子节点，所以枪/剑跟随视角旋转；
## - 切换武器时广播 weapon_changed，由世界脚本换准星。

signal weapon_changed(weapon_id, crosshair_style)

const WEAPON_RIG_SCRIPT := preload("res://scripts/weapon_rig.gd")
const INPUT_SETUP := preload("res://scripts/input_map_setup.gd")

const WALK_SPEED := 4.6
const SPRINT_SPEED := 7.2
const ACCELERATION := 22.0
const JUMP_VELOCITY := 4.8
const GRAVITY := 12.0
const MOUSE_SENSITIVITY := 0.0022
const PITCH_LIMIT_DEG := 85.0

var camera: Camera3D
var head: Node3D
var weapon_rig

var _yaw := 0.0
var _pitch := 0.0
var _mouse_captured := true


func _init() -> void:
	# 身体碰撞体
	var shape := CollisionShape3D.new()
	shape.name = "Body"
	var capsule := CapsuleShape3D.new()
	capsule.radius = 0.35
	capsule.height = 1.8
	shape.shape = capsule
	shape.position = Vector3(0.0, 0.9, 0.0)
	add_child(shape)

	# 头部（俯仰）
	head = Node3D.new()
	head.name = "Head"
	head.position = Vector3(0.0, 1.6, 0.0)
	add_child(head)

	# 第一人称相机
	camera = Camera3D.new()
	camera.name = "Camera3D"
	camera.fov = 75.0
	camera.near = 0.05
	camera.far = 500.0
	camera.current = true
	head.add_child(camera)

	# 武器挂点：直接挂在相机下 => 跟随视角旋转
	weapon_rig = WEAPON_RIG_SCRIPT.new()
	weapon_rig.name = "WeaponRig"
	camera.add_child(weapon_rig)


func _ready() -> void:
	INPUT_SETUP.ensure_actions()
	_mouse_captured = true
	Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED
	weapon_rig.weapon_changed.connect(_on_weapon_changed)
	_on_weapon_changed(weapon_rig.current_weapon, weapon_rig.crosshair_style)


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventMouseMotion:
		var motion := event as InputEventMouseMotion
		if motion != null and _mouse_captured:
			_look(motion.relative)
		return

	if event.is_action_pressed("release_mouse"):
		_set_mouse_captured(not _mouse_captured)
		return

	if not _mouse_captured:
		if event is InputEventMouseButton and (event as InputEventMouseButton).pressed:
			_set_mouse_captured(true)
		return

	if event.is_action_pressed("weapon_toggle"):
		weapon_rig.toggle_weapon()
	elif event.is_action_pressed("weapon_pistol"):
		weapon_rig.equip(&"pistol")
	elif event.is_action_pressed("weapon_sword"):
		weapon_rig.equip(&"sword")
	elif event.is_action_pressed("fire"):
		weapon_rig.fire()


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not is_on_floor():
		velocity.y -= GRAVITY * delta

	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("jump") and is_on_floor():
		velocity.y = JUMP_VELOCITY

	var input_dir := Input.get_vector("move_left", "move_right", "move_forward", "move_back")
	var direction := (transform.basis * Vector3(input_dir.x, 0.0, input_dir.y)).normalized()
	var sprinting := Input.is_action_pressed("move_forward") and Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_SHIFT)
	var target := direction * (SPRINT_SPEED if sprinting else WALK_SPEED)
	velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, target.x, ACCELERATION * delta)
	velocity.z = move_toward(velocity.z, target.z, ACCELERATION * delta)
	move_and_slide()

	if weapon_rig != null:
		weapon_rig.set_move_state(Vector2(velocity.x, velocity.z).length(), is_on_floor())


func _look(relative: Vector2) -> void:
	_yaw -= relative.x * MOUSE_SENSITIVITY
	_pitch -= relative.y * MOUSE_SENSITIVITY
	_pitch = clampf(_pitch, -deg_to_rad(PITCH_LIMIT_DEG), deg_to_rad(PITCH_LIMIT_DEG))
	rotation.y = _yaw
	head.rotation.x = _pitch
	if weapon_rig != null:
		weapon_rig.add_look_delta(relative)


func _set_mouse_captured(captured: bool) -> void:
	_mouse_captured = captured
	Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED if captured else Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE


func _on_weapon_changed(weapon_id, crosshair_style) -> void:
	weapon_changed.emit(weapon_id, crosshair_style)

extends Node3D

## 世界组装脚本（main.tscn 的根节点）。
## 顺序：输入动作 -> 环境/灯光 -> 关卡几何 -> 玩家 -> HUD 准星。

const PLAYER_SCRIPT := preload("res://scripts/player.gd")
const CROSSHAIR_SCRIPT := preload("res://scripts/crosshair.gd")
const INPUT_SETUP := preload("res://scripts/input_map_setup.gd")

const GROUND_SIZE := 60.0

var player
var crosshair
var _weapon_label: Label


func _ready() -> void:
	INPUT_SETUP.ensure_actions()
	_build_environment()
	_build_level()
	_spawn_player()
	_build_hud()


func _build_environment() -> void:
	var env := Environment.new()
	env.background_mode = Environment.BG_SKY
	var sky := Sky.new()
	var sky_mat := ProceduralSkyMaterial.new()
	sky_mat.sky_top_color = Color(0.25, 0.42, 0.7)
	sky_mat.sky_horizon_color = Color(0.66, 0.73, 0.82)
	sky_mat.ground_horizon_color = Color(0.5, 0.5, 0.52)
	sky_mat.ground_bottom_color = Color(0.18, 0.18, 0.2)
	sky.sky_material = sky_mat
	env.sky = sky
	env.ambient_light_source = Environment.AMBIENT_SOURCE_SKY
	env.ambient_light_energy = 0.7

	var world_env := WorldEnvironment.new()
	world_env.name = "WorldEnvironment"
	world_env.environment = env
	add_child(world_env)

	var sun := DirectionalLight3D.new()
	sun.name = "Sun"
	sun.rotation = Vector3(deg_to_rad(-52.0), deg_to_rad(-38.0), 0.0)
	sun.light_energy = 1.2
	sun.shadow_enabled = true
	add_child(sun)


func _build_level() -> void:
	# 地面（顶面在 y = 0）
	_add_platform(Vector3(0.0, -0.5, 0.0), Vector3(GROUND_SIZE, 1.0, GROUND_SIZE), Color(0.33, 0.35, 0.4))
	# 前方靶墙
	_add_platform(Vector3(0.0, 1.5, -18.0), Vector3(26.0, 3.0, 1.0), Color(0.42, 0.4, 0.36))
	# 一排靶箱（正好在准星高度附近）
	for i in 4:
		var x := -6.0 + float(i) * 4.0
		_add_platform(Vector3(x, 0.6, -8.0), Vector3(1.2, 1.2, 1.2), Color(0.74, 0.36, 0.28))
	# 左右墙，给出空间纵深
	_add_platform(Vector3(-14.0, 2.0, -6.0), Vector3(1.0, 4.0, 26.0), Color(0.3, 0.31, 0.34))
	_add_platform(Vector3(14.0, 2.0, -6.0), Vector3(1.0, 4.0, 26.0), Color(0.3, 0.31, 0.34))


func _add_platform(center: Vector3, size: Vector3, color: Color) -> void:
	var body := StaticBody3D.new()
	body.name = "Platform"
	body.position = center

	var shape := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var box := BoxShape3D.new()
	box.size = size
	shape.shape = box
	body.add_child(shape)

	var mesh := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var box_mesh := BoxMesh.new()
	box_mesh.size = size
	mesh.mesh = box_mesh
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.albedo_color = color
	mat.roughness = 0.85
	mesh.material_override = mat
	body.add_child(mesh)

	add_child(body)


func _spawn_player() -> void:
	player = PLAYER_SCRIPT.new()
	player.name = "Player"
	player.position = Vector3(0.0, 0.05, 6.0)
	add_child(player)


func _build_hud() -> void:
	var layer := CanvasLayer.new()
	layer.name = "HUD"
	layer.layer = 10
	add_child(layer)

	# 中央准星（铺满视口的 Control，绘制在视口正中）
	crosshair = CROSSHAIR_SCRIPT.new()
	crosshair.name = "Crosshair"
	layer.add_child(crosshair)

	_weapon_label = Label.new()
	_weapon_label.name = "WeaponLabel"
	_weapon_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 22)
	_weapon_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.96, 0.98, 1.0))
	_weapon_label.add_theme_color_override("font_shadow_color", Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.75))
	_weapon_label.add_theme_constant_override("shadow_offset_x", 1)
	_weapon_label.add_theme_constant_override("shadow_offset_y", 1)
	layer.add_child(_weapon_label)
	_weapon_label.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_BOTTOM_RIGHT)
	_weapon_label.position = Vector2(-300.0, -66.0)

	var help := Label.new()
	help.name = "Help"
	help.text = "WASD 移动 · 鼠标转视角 · Q / 1 / 2 切换武器 · 左键 开火或挥剑 · Esc 释放鼠标"
	help.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16)
	help.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.9, 0.94, 1.0, 0.85))
	layer.add_child(help)
	help.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_LEFT)
	help.position = Vector2(18.0, 14.0)

	player.weapon_changed.connect(_on_weapon_changed)
	# 推送一次初始状态，保证开局准星和标签就是当前武器
	_on_weapon_changed(player.weapon_rig.current_weapon, player.weapon_rig.crosshair_style)


func _on_weapon_changed(weapon_id, crosshair_style) -> void:
	if crosshair != null:
		crosshair.set_style(crosshair_style)
	if _weapon_label != null:
		_weapon_label.text = "当前武器：%s" % _weapon_display_name(weapon_id)


func _weapon_display_name(weapon_id) -> String:
	if weapon_id == &"sword":
		return "长剑（准星：圆环）"
	return "手枪（准星：十字）"

const SWORD_COLOR := Color(0.96, 0.9, 0.62, 0.9)

const SPREAD_SWORD := 10.0

## 细线样式参数
const LINE_WIDTH := 1.0
const ARM_LENGTH := 7.0
const DOT_RADIUS := 1.0
const RING_RADIUS := 14.0
const RING_SEGMENTS := 72
const RING_TICK_LENGTH := 5.0

var style: StringName = STYLE_PISTOL

var _spread := SPREAD_PISTOL


func _ready() -> void:

	focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
	z_index = 100
	queue_redraw()


func set_style(new_style: StringName) -> void:
	if style == new_style:
		return
	style = new_style
	queue_redraw()


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	var target := SPREAD_SWORD if style == STYLE_SWORD else SPREAD_PISTOL
	var next_spread := lerpf(_spread, target, clampf(delta * 10.0, 0.0, 1.0))
	if absf(next_spread - _spread) > 0.01:

		queue_redraw()

	return get_viewport_rect().size * 0.5


func _draw() -> void:
	var center := _viewport_center()

		_draw_sword_style(center)

		_draw_pistol_style(center)


func _draw_pistol_style(center: Vector2) -> void:
	var color := CROSSHAIR_COLOR
	var gap := _spread
	var length := ARM_LENGTH
	var width := LINE_WIDTH

	draw_line(center + Vector2(gap, 0.0), center + Vector2(gap + length, 0.0), color, width, true)
	draw_line(center + Vector2(0.0, -gap - length), center + Vector2(0.0, -gap), color, width, true)
	draw_line(center + Vector2(0.0, gap), center + Vector2(0.0, gap + length), color, width, true)

	draw_line(center + Vector2(radius, 0.0), center + Vector2(radius + RING_TICK_LENGTH, 0.0), color, LINE_WIDTH, true)

## 相机坐标系里的持枪姿态（右下方、镜头前方）
const REST_POSITION := Vector3(0.26, -0.22, -0.42)
const SWING_DURATION := 0.34

## 待机呼吸：角频率约 1.7 rad/s（≈3.7 秒一个周期），幅度保持轻微
const BREATH_SPEED := 1.7
const BREATH_POSITION := Vector3(0.004, 0.006, 0.0)
const BREATH_ROTATION := Vector3(0.012, 0.008, 0.0)
const IDLE_SPEED_THRESHOLD := 0.3

var current_weapon: StringName = PISTOL
var crosshair_style: StringName = CROSSHAIR_PISTOL

var _models := {}
var _sway := Vector3.ZERO
var _sway_target := Vector3.ZERO
var _recoil := 0.0
var _swing_time := 0.0
var _bob_time := 0.0
var _move_speed := 0.0
var _grounded := true
var _breath_time := 0.0
var _idle_blend := 0.0


func _init() -> void:
	_models[PISTOL] = WEAPON_MODELS.build_pistol()
	_models[SWORD] = WEAPON_MODELS.build_sword()
	for id in _models:
		var model: Node3D = _models[id]
		model.visible = false
		add_child(model)
	position = REST_POSITION


func _ready() -> void:
	_apply_weapon(PISTOL)


func equip(weapon_id: StringName) -> void:
	if not _models.has(weapon_id):
		push_warning("未知武器: %s" % String(weapon_id))
		return
	if weapon_id == current_weapon:
		return
	_apply_weapon(weapon_id)


func toggle_weapon() -> void:
	equip(SWORD if current_weapon == PISTOL else PISTOL)


func _apply_weapon(weapon_id: StringName) -> void:
	current_weapon = weapon_id
	for id in _models:
		var model: Node3D = _models[id]
		model.visible = (id == weapon_id)
	crosshair_style = CROSSHAIR_SWORD if weapon_id == SWORD else CROSSHAIR_PISTOL
	_recoil = 0.0
	_swing_time = 0.0
	weapon_changed.emit(current_weapon, crosshair_style)


func fire() -> void:
	if current_weapon == SWORD:
		_swing_time = SWING_DURATION
	else:
		_recoil = 1.0


func add_look_delta(relative: Vector2) -> void:
	var limit := 0.05
	_sway_target.x = clampf(_sway_target.x - relative.x * 0.0005, -limit, limit)
	_sway_target.y = clampf(_sway_target.y - relative.y * 0.0004, -limit, limit)


func set_move_state(speed: float, grounded: bool) -> void:
	_move_speed = speed
	_grounded = grounded


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	_sway = _sway.lerp(_sway_target, clampf(delta * 10.0, 0.0, 1.0))
	_sway_target = _sway_target.lerp(Vector3.ZERO, clampf(delta * 6.0, 0.0, 1.0))
	_recoil = move_toward(_recoil, 0.0, delta * 5.0)

	var bob := Vector3.ZERO
	if _grounded and _move_speed > IDLE_SPEED_THRESHOLD:
		_bob_time += delta * _move_speed
		bob = Vector3(sin(_bob_time * 5.0) * 0.014, -absf(cos(_bob_time * 5.0)) * 0.012, 0.0)

	# 待机呼吸：只有站定不动、且没有开火/挥击时才完全生效，
	# 用 _idle_blend 平滑进出，避免和移动摆动、后坐、挥击互相打架。
	var idle_target := 0.0
	if _grounded and _move_speed <= IDLE_SPEED_THRESHOLD and _swing_time <= 0.0 and _recoil <= 0.01:
		idle_target = 1.0
	_idle_blend = lerpf(_idle_blend, idle_target, clampf(delta * 4.0, 0.0, 1.0))
	_breath_time += delta * BREATH_SPEED
	var breath := Vector3(
		sin(_breath_time) * BREATH_POSITION.x,
		sin(_breath_time * 2.0) * BREATH_POSITION.y,
		0.0) * _idle_blend
	var breath_rot := Vector3(
		sin(_breath_time * 2.0 + 0.9) * BREATH_ROTATION.x,
		sin(_breath_time + 0.4) * BREATH_ROTATION.y,
		0.0) * _idle_blend

	if _swing_time > 0.0:
		_swing_time = maxf(0.0, _swing_time - delta)
		var t := 1.0 - (_swing_time / SWING_DURATION)
		var arc := sin(t * PI)
		position = REST_POSITION + _sway + bob + breath + Vector3(0.0, -arc * 0.05, 0.0)
		rotation = Vector3(-arc * 1.25, arc * 0.45, arc * 0.85) + breath_rot
	else:
		position = REST_POSITION + _sway + bob + breath + Vector3(0.0, 0.0, _recoil * 0.1)
		rotation = Vector3(-_recoil * 0.4, _sway.x * 1.5, 0.0) + breath_rot
